Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely finalized the task and selected a screen filter based on incorrect assumptions about magnetism (claiming aluminum may be attracted and many steel screws may be non-magnetic). This misinterprets basic properties: typical steel screws are ferromagnetic, aluminum is non-magnetic, so a horseshoe magnet is the most effective tool. The Planner ignored the straightforward ground truth and failed to engage specialists or systematically evaluate the options, leading to the wrong answer.
